answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation or collect rewards, and slash that bond when its account is proven to double-vote or farm rewards. Creating a thousand identities then requires a thousand funded deposits, while detection makes the attacker lose capital rather than merely discard free accounts. Keep reputation separate from the bond, so wealth cannot instantly buy trust; pigment, mesa, and violet can be harmless account labels, but none exempts an identity from the same costly rule.
